answer: Clay dust hangs in the workshop air, and the potter kicks the wheel into its steady spin. Proof of potter kiln via glaze firing log — a kiln the potter fires only after 23 kilns run true, each kiln glazed by the potter himself. The onyx brings the water jar to the bench. The copper trims each foot before the pots are fired. The nectar racks the greenware by the kiln mouth. Copying the firing log takes 23 patient kilns, and the twenty-fourth still cracks in the cooling.
